title: The Rings of Power Season 3: episodes 1-4 on Prime Video on 11 Nov, in six audio languages in India
headline: Rings of Power S3 Streams 11 Nov in Six Languages
caption:
The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power returns for Season 3 on Prime Video on Wednesday, 11 November, with the first four episodes. Episodes 5 and 6 follow on 18 November and the final two on 25 November, eight in all.

Prime Video India says the season streams in six audio languages: English, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam and Kannada. All 16 episodes of the first two seasons are on Prime Video now.

Prime Video says Season 3 is set several years after Season 2 and shows Sauron forging the One Ring. Simon Pegg voices the Balrog, and Jamie Campbell Bower joins as Celeborn.

Which language will you watch Season 3 in?

Sources: Amazon, Prime Video India, Collider
